name: Brisbane
industries: Olympics-driven infrastructure, resources-sector programs and a growing tech scene define Brisbane's project decade.
intro:
Brisbane is building toward a deadline the whole city can see: the 2032 Olympics anchor an infrastructure program — Cross River Rail, venues, transport upgrades — that has made south-east Queensland one of Australia's busiest project markets. The resources sector runs its Queensland capital programs from Brisbane towers, and a growing tech scene rounds out demand. PMP suits the infrastructure and resources world; Scrum credentials the digital side. Batches are scheduled live online across the whole year at hours built for Brisbane: a weekend Sat–Sun cohort and a weekday Wed–Thu cohort each week, all landing in comfortable local daytime; every upcoming date and its exact Brisbane timing is listed in the schedule below. The package holds: live weekend instruction, exam application support, full-length mocks, and trainer access until you pass.

Brisbane is delivering toward a deadline the whole country can see: the 2032 Games and the infrastructure program around them, layered on Queensland's resources sector and a growing tech scene, have turned the city into a project-hiring market with a decade of runway. Certified project professionals slot into that pipeline's governance structures immediately. The course runs live online across two consecutive days shown in Brisbane local time on this page. Queensland compensation for certified roles is closing on the southern capitals as demand outruns supply; the sourced Brisbane entries in the salary table below give the current picture with names and dates. The employer list reflects the infrastructure-resources-tech mix, and delivery consortia can certify program teams through private cohorts.
